verses.en: This then was the lot of the tribe of the children of Judah by their families; even to the border of Edom the wilderness of Zin southward was the uttermost part of the south coast.
verses.sm: Iutā O le tofi lenei o le itu aiga o le fanauga a Iuta e tu3a ma o latou aiga, e oo ile tuaoi 0 Etoma, o le vao o Tisina i le itu i toga, o le mea lea e gata mai ai le itu i toga.

verses.en: And their south border was from the shore of the salt sea, from the bay that looketh southward:
verses.sm: O lo latou tuaoi i le itu i toga ua afua mal i le mea e gata mai ai le sami Oona,

verses.en: And it went out to the south side to Maaleh-acrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and ascended up on the south side unto Kadesh-barnea, and passed along to Hezron, and went up to Adar, and fetched a compass to Karkaa:
verses.sm: e afua mai foi i le faga e faasaga i le itu i toga; 3ae alu atu i le itu i toga i le aega o Akarava, ma ul atu Tisini, ma alu ae i le itu i toga i Katesapanea, ma ui ai i Hasaronu, ma alu ae i Atara, ma ui ane i Karaka;

verses.en: From thence it passed toward Azmon, and went out unto the river of Egypt; and the goings out of that coast were at the sea: this shall be your south coast.
verses.sm: ona ui atu ai lea i Asemoni, ma alu atu i le alia o Aikupito; o lona gataaga mai o lea tuaoi o le sami lea. O lo outou tuaoi lea i le itu i toga.

verses.en: And the east border was the salt sea, even unto the end of Jordan. And their border in the north quarter was from the bay of the sea at the uttermost part of Jordan:
verses.sm: O le tuaoi i sasae o le sami Oona, e oo atu i le mea e gata mai ai Ioritana. O le tuaoi i le itu i matu e afua mai i le faga o le sami i le mea e gata mai ai loritana;

verses.en: And the border went up to Beth-hogla, and passed along by the north of Beth-arabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben:
verses.sm: a e alu ae le tuaoi i Peteokelu, ma ui ai i le itu i matu o Petearapa; ua alu ae foi le tuaoi i le maa o Poana le atalii o Reupena.

verses.en: And the border went up toward Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, that is before the going up to Adummim, which is on the south side of the river: and the border passed toward the waters of En-shemesh, and the goings out thereof were at En-rogel:
verses.sm: Ona alu ae ai lea o le tuaoi i Tiperi mai le vanu o Akori, e ui ai i le itu i matu e faasaga atu i Kilikala, e feagai ma le aega i Atumema, o i le itu i toga o le alia; ona ui ai lea o le tuaoi i le vai o Enesemesa, o lona gataaga mai o i Enerokelu.

verses.en: And the border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom unto the south side of the Jebusite; the same is Jerusalem: and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lieth before the valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the end of the valley of the giants northward:
verses.sm: Ona alu ac ai lea o le tuaoi i le yanu o le atalii o Hinoma e oo atu i le itu i toga o sa Iepuse, o Ierusalema lea; e alu ae foi le tuaoi i le tumutumu o le mauga e feagai ma le vanu o Hinoma i sisifo, o i le mea e gata mai ai le vanu o sa Rafa i le itu i matu;

verses.en: And the border was drawn from the top of the hill unto the fountain of the water of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of mount Ephron; and the border was drawn to Baalah, which is Kirjath-jearim:
verses.sm: ua tusia foi le tuaoi e afua mai i le tumutumu o le mauga, e oo atu i le vaipuna o Nafatoa. ua alu atu foi i aai.o le mauga o Eferona; ua tusia foi le tuaoi i Paala, o Kiriata-iarima lea.

verses.en: And the border compassed from Baalah westward unto mount Seir, and passed along unto the side of mount Jearim, which is Chesalon, on the north side, and went down to Beth-shemesh, and passed on to Timnah:
verses.sm: Ona afe lea o le tuaoi mai Paala i sisifo, e oo atu i le mauga o Seira, ua ui atu foi i le tafatafa o le mauga o larima i le itu i matu, o Kasalona lea; ona alu ifo ai lea i Petesemesa, ma ui atu ai i Timena.

verses.en: And the border went out unto the side of Ekron northward: and the border was drawn to Shicron, and passed along to mount Baalah, and went out unto Jabneel; and the goings out of the border were at the sea.
verses.sm: Ua alu atu le tuaoi i le tafatafa o Ekerona i le itu i matu; ua tusia foi le tuaoi i Sekerona, ma ui ai i ie mauga o Paala, ma alu atu i lapenelu; o lona gataaga mai o le tuaoi o le sami lea.

verses.en: And the west border was to the great sea, and the coast thereof. This is the coast of the children of Judah round about according to their families.
verses.sm: O le tuaoi i sisifo o le sami tele lea ma ona tuaoi. O le tuaoi lea o le fanauga a Iuta e faataaliolio ai, e tusa ma o latou aiga.

verses.en: And unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh he gave a part among the children of Judah, according to the commandment of the LORD to Joshua, even the city of Arba the father of Anak, which city is Hebron.
verses.sm: Ua avatu foi e ia se tofi ia Kalepo le atalii o Iefune, faatasi ma le fanauga a Iuta, e pei o le afioga a le ALII ia Iosua, o le aai o Arapa le tata o Anaki, o Heperona lea.

verses.en: And Caleb drove thence the three sons of Anak, Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.
verses.sm: Ona tulia lea ai lea mea e Kalepo o atalii e toatolu o Anaki, o Sesai, ma Aimano, ma Talemai, o le fanau a Anaki.

verses.en: And he went up thence to the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before was Kirjath-sepher.
verses.sm: Ona alu ae lea o ia ai lea mea i e o nonofo i Tiperi; (o le igoa foi o Tiperi anumua o Kiriata-sapera).

verses.en: And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kirjath-sepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea o Kalepo, O se na te fasia Kiriata-sapera ma na maua, ou te avatu ia te ia o Akesa lo‘u afafine e fai mana ava.

verses.en: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.
verses.sm: Ona maua lea e Otinielu le atalii o Kinasa, le uso o Kalepo; ua avatu e ia ia te ia o Akesa lona afafine e fai mana ava.

verses.en: And it came to pass, as she came unto him, that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she lighted off her ass; and Caleb said unto her, What wouldest thou?
verses.sm: Ua alu atu o ja, ona faaoso atu lea o ia ia te ia, ia ole atu i lona tama ise fanua. Ua alu ifo o ia nai le asini, ona fai mai ai lea o Kalepo ia te ia, Se a ea lou manao?

verses.en: Who answered, Give me a blessing; for thou hast given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And he gave her the upper springs, and the nether springs.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o ia, la e foai mai ia te au se mea alofa; ua e avane ia te au le fanua i le itu i toga, ia e foai mai foi ia te au ma ni vaipuna. Ona avatu ai lea e ia ia te ia o vaipuna o i luga ma vaipuna o i lalo.

verses.en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families.
verses.sm: O le tofi lenei o le itu aiga o le fanauga a Iuta, e tusa ma o latou aiga.

verses.en: And the uttermost cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the coast of Edom southward were Kabzeel, and Eder, and Jagur,
verses.sm: O aai tupito o le itu aiga o le fanauga a luta, i le tuaoi o Etoma i le itu i toga, o Kapeseelu, ma Eteru, ma lakuri,

verses.en: And Kinah, and Dimonah, and Adadah,
verses.sm: ma Kina, ma Timuna, ma Atata,

verses.en: And Kedesh, and Hazor, and Ithnan,
verses.sm: ma Katesa, ma Hasora, ma Itanana,

verses.en: Ziph, and Telem, and Bealoth,
verses.sm: o Sefa, ma Telema, ma Paalota,

verses.en: And Hazor, Hadattah, and Kerioth, and Hezron, which is Hazor,
verses.sm: ma Hasora, ma Hatata, ma Kiriota, ma Hasaronu, o Hasora lea;

verses.en: Amam, and Shema, and Moladah,
verses.sm: o Amama, ma Sema, ma Molata,

verses.en: And Hazar-gaddah, and Heshmon, and Beth-palet,
verses.sm: ma Asarakata, ma Hasamoni, ma Petepaleta,

verses.en: And Hazar-shual, and Beer-sheba, and Bizjothjah,
verses.sm: ma Asara-suala, ma Peresepa, ma Pisetia,

verses.en: Baalah, and Iim, and Azem,
verses.sm: o Paala, ma lima, ma Asema,

verses.en: And Eltolad, and Chesil, and Hormah,
verses.sm: ma Elitolita, ma Kiselu, ma Horema,

verses.en: And Ziklag, and Madmannah, and Sansannah,
verses.sm: ma Sekeleka, ma Matamana, ma Sanesana,

verses.en: And Lebaoth, and Shilhim, and Ain, and Rimmon: all the cities are twenty and nine, with their villages:
verses.sm: ma Lepaota, ma Seleima, ma Aino, ma Rimoni; o aai uma ia c lua sefulu ma le iva, atoa ma o iatou faoa aai;

verses.en: And in the valley, Eshtaol, and Zoreah, and Ashnah,
verses.sm: o i le nuu maulalo, o Esetaola, ma Soraa, ma Asena,

verses.en: And Zanoah, and En-gannim, Tappuah, and Enam,
verses.sm: ma Sanoa, ma Enekanima, o Tapua, ma Enama,

verses.en: Jarmuth, and Adullam, Socoh, and Azekah,
verses.sm: o laremuta, ma Atulame, o Suka, ma Aseka,

verses.en: And Sharaim, and Adithaim, and Gederah, and Gederothaim; fourteen cities with their villages:
verses.sm: ma Saraima, ma Atitaima, ma Ketere, ma Keteretaima; o aai e sefulu ma le fa, atoa ma o latou faoa aai.

verses.en: Zenan, and Hadashah, and Migdal-gad,
verses.sm: O Senana, ma Hatesa, ma Meketala-kato,

verses.en: And Dilean, and Mizpeh, and Joktheel,
verses.sm: ma Tileano, ma Mesepa, ma Iokatielu,

verses.en: Lachish, and Bozkath, and Eglon,
verses.sm: o Lakisa, ma Posekata, ma Ekelona,

verses.en: And Cabbon, and Lahmam, and Kithlish,
verses.sm: ma Kapona, ma Lakemase, ma Kitelisa,

verses.en: And Gederoth, Beth-dagon, and Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages:
verses.sm: ma Kiterota, o Petetakona, ma Naama, ma Maketa; o aai e sefulu ma le ono, ma o latou faoa aai.

verses.en: Libnah, and Ether, and Ashan,
verses.sm: O Lipena, ma Eteru, ma Asana,

verses.en: And Jiphtah, and Ashnah, and Nezib,
verses.sm: ma lefeta, ma Asena, ma Nisepa,

verses.en: And Keilah, and Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities with their villages:
verses.sm: ma Kaila, ma Akasepa, ma Morese; o aai e iva, ma o latou faoa aai.

verses.en: Ekron, with her towns and her villages:
verses.sm: O Ekerona, ma ona aai, ma ona faoa aai.

verses.en: From Ekron even unto the sea, all that lay near Ashdod, with their villages:
verses.sm: E afua mai i Ekerona ma le sami, o aai uma e latalata i Asetota, ma o latou faoa aai.

verses.en: Ashdod with her towns and her villages, Gaza with her towns and her villages, unto the river of Egypt, and the great sea, and the border thereof:
verses.sm: O Asetota, ma ona aai, ma ona faoa aai, o Kasa, ma ona aai, ma ona faoa aai, e oo atu i le alia o Aikupito, ma le sami tele, ma ona tuaoi.

verses.en: And in the mountains, Shamir, and Jattir, and Socoh,
verses.sm: O i le atu mauga, o Samira, ma latira, ma Suka,

verses.en: And Dannah, and Kirjath-sannah, which is Debir,
verses.sm: ma Tana, ma Kiriata-sena, o Tiperi lea,

verses.en: And Anab, and Eshtemoh, and Anim,
verses.sm: so ma Anapa, ma Esetemoa, ma Anima,

verses.en: And Goshen, and Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities with their villages:
verses.sm: ma Kosena, ma Holona, ma Kilo; o aai e sefulu ma le tasi, ma o latou faoa aai.

verses.en: Arab, and Dumah, and Eshean,
verses.sm: O Arapa, ma Tuma, ma Eseana,

verses.en: And Janum, and Beth-tappuah, and Aphekah,
verses.sm: ma lanuma, ma Petetapua, ma Afeka,

verses.en: And Humtah, and Kirjath-arba, which is Hebron, and Zior; nine cities with their villages:
verses.sm: ma Umeta, ma Kiriataarapa, O Heperona lea, ma Seora; O aai e iva mao latou faoa aai.

verses.en: Maon, Carmel, and Ziph, and Juttah,
verses.sm: O Meona, ma Karamelu, ma Sefa, ma lutaa,

verses.en: And Jezreel, and Jokdeam, and Zanoah,
verses.sm: ma Isereelu, ma lakatoma, ma Sanoa;

verses.en: Cain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities with their villages:
verses.sm: o Kaino, o Kipea, ma Timena; o aai e sefulu ma o latou faoa aai.

verses.en: Halhul, Beth-zur, and Gedor,
verses.sm: O Aliula, o Petesura, ma Kitoru,

verses.en: And Maarath, and Beth-anoth, and Eltekon; six cities with their villages:
verses.sm: ma Mearata, ma Peteanata, ma Aletekono; o aai e ono ma o latou faoa aai.

verses.en: Kirjath-baal, which is Kirjath-jearim, and Rabbah; two cities with their villages:
verses.sm: O Kiriata-paala, o Kiriataiarima lea, ma Rapa; o aai e lua ma o la faoa aai.

verses.en: In the wilderness, Beth-arabah, Middin, and Secacah,
verses.sm: O i le vao, o Petearapa, o Metina, ma Sekaka,

verses.en: And Nibshan, and the city of Salt, and En-gedi; six cities with their villages.
verses.sm: ma Nivasana, ma le aai o masima, ma Enokati; o aai e ono ma o latou faoa aai.

verses.en: As for the Jebusites the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah could not drive them out: but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Judah at Jerusalem unto this day.
verses.sm: A o sa Iepuse, o e nonofo i Ierusalema, na le mafai ona tulia i latou e le fanauga a luta; a ua nonofo faatasi O sa Iepusé ma le fanauga a Iuta i
